mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task_events (task_id, agent_id, event_type, event_data, seq, created_at) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{agentId}, #{eventType, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{eventData}, #{seq}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, task_id, agent_id, event_type, event_data, seq, created_at FROM task_events WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY seq ASC
SELECT id, task_id, agent_id, event_type, event_data, seq, created_at FROM task_events ORDER BY seq DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id, task_id, agent_id, event_type, event_data, seq, created_at FROM task_events WHERE seq BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} ORDER BY seq ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task_events WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
